content.title: Raised blood pressure estimate
content.body: Your blood pressure was estimated at 128/84 mmHg and your heart rate was around 72 bpm. A normal range sits below 120 over 80. This is a screening signal and not a diagnosis. Keep an eye on it and try to cut down on salty food over the next few weeks.
recommendations: Reduce salt in your meals over the next 2 weeks.
Repeat the scan each morning for a week.
